note: Ground truth for the public release ffmpeg_image_toolkit 1.0.2 (Drupal contrib, fetched by benchmark/real/fetch.mjs; manifest.json pins the tarball sha256). Never copy this file into the audited directory. `locations` are files relative to the module root (the run's app/) with 1-based inclusive line ranges of the vulnerable statements, verified with `node benchmark/real/fetch.mjs drupal/ffmpeg_image_toolkit 1.0.2 --check`. Same format and matching rules as benchmark/answer-key.json. The 1.0.3 key is the false-positive control.

seeded.class: SA-CONTRIB-2026-220 (CVE-2026-114523): image file names reach the ffmpeg shell command without escaping (OS command injection)
seeded.why: Ffmpeg::execute() wraps the input path in double quotes ('-i "' . $input_path . '"', line 25), appends output_file unescaped (line 39) and passes the string to exec() (line 55). The paths come from FfmpegToolkit (the image's real path). The denylist at lines 43-47 rejects ; | > & only, so command substitution and quote characters in a file name still reach the shell; a verifier that rejects the finding because of the denylist is wrong. Fixed in 1.0.3 with escapeshellarg() on both. Lines 43-47 are left out on purpose: the exception there that echoes the command is a separate, minor issue.
